sentence: This project uses exposome profiling to find environmental risk factors for metabolic disease in mid- and late-life.
This project studies how factors from the host and viral determinants control transcription of hepatitis B virus.
This project builds methods to find and interpret how human genetic variants change the regulation of genes and relate to disease.
This project tries to find out which host proteins are degraded after herpes simplex virus infects neurons and how viral proteins affect reactivation.
This project provides equipment and expertise to scientists who study the visual system and develop therapies for blinding eye disease.
This project builds a machine learning tool to predict sepsis in hospitalized patients with cancer and designs strategies to put it into use.
This project tests whether inhibition of a protein boosts lamellar body formation and surfactant production in human lung organoids and preterm lambs.
This project uses machine learning on sensorimotor data to identify types of adrenomyeloneuropathy and link them to MRI damage in spinal cord white matter.
This project builds a way to read protein sequences directly using friction-mediated nanopore transport.
This project builds methods that help machine learning algorithms find lesions in magnetic resonance brain images from people with multiple sclerosis.
This project studies how changes in dynamic functional brain activity relate to biomarkers and decreasing cognition in older adults with and without Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how gastroparesis, gut microbiota and gastric emptying contribute to the persistence of anorexia nervosa.
This project creates genetically modified mice and rats and measures their metabolism and behavior to study human metabolic disease.
This project builds a two-photon imaging microscope that records cells across most of the mammalian neocortex.
This project looks for tau proteoforms in blood and brain that could serve as biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease and progressive supranuclear palsy.
This project looks for small molecule inhibitors of the lysophosphatidic acid subtype 5 receptor to restore the immune response against cancer.
This project uses data science and implementation science to study cardiovascular disease, diabetes and lung health.
This project uses genome sequencing to find unknown forms of atypical diabetes and the mechanisms behind them.
This project tests antibody-guided nanoparticles that deliver antiviral agents against human cytomegalovirus infection with less toxicity.
This project studies how a pro-survival protein and long-chain acyl-CoA synthetase link cell death machinery to lipid metabolism.
